meta.title: Bots
meta.description: Adds a Bots section above Workspaces in the sidebar. Each bot has a name, an avatar, its own virtual machine (where its working directory lives) and a Main session; the bot's other sessions are listed under it. Also provides the shared bot service other bot plugins use. On a bot's session the chat screen shows the bot's face and name, Chat only, and a menu bar of bot actions; the bot's files open in a viewer there instead of the right sidebar.
